posts.title: I’m Shutting Down the Weblog
posts.description: I no longer intend to maintain my personal weblog, and therefore I’m shutting it down. The project’s source code remains available on GitHub. When I have more spare time, all entries will be moved to an archive, and the weblog’s main page will be replaced with a new static one. posts.title: Wiegenlied für Züge
posts.description: Old steam trains often had whistles that worked much like organ pipes, as both are labial aerophones, instruments where air splits against a sharp edge to create sound. Perhaps that’s why trains always seemed so alive to me. I breathe. They breathe. Organs breathe. This might be how a choir of trains would sound, gathered together in a depot before sleep. coignard.org/wiegenlied-fuer-zuege
